sources.name: code-review
sources.description: Two-axis review of a diff: repository standards and the originating spec, run as parallel sub-agents.

sources.name: codebase-design
sources.description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules.

sources.name: diagnosing-bugs
sources.description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions.

sources.name: domain-modeling
sources.description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model and ubiquitous language.

sources.name: grill-with-docs
sources.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADRs and a glossary) as it goes. Imported because setup-matt-pocock-skills points its domain documentation flow at it.

sources.name: grilling
sources.description: Stress-test a plan, decision or idea by grilling the user relentlessly. Imported here because improve-codebase-architecture, triage, wayfinder and grill-with-docs all invoke it.

sources.name: improve-codebase-architecture
sources.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities and report them, then grill through one.

sources.name: research
sources.description: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture the findings as a Markdown file in the repository. Imported because wayfinder delegates its reading legwork to it.

sources.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
sources.description: One-off repository setup the engineering skills expect: issue tracker, triage labels, domain docs.

sources.name: to-tickets
sources.description: Break a plan or spec into tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blockers.

sources.name: triage
sources.description: Move issues and external pull requests through a state machine of triage roles: categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

sources.name: wayfinder
sources.description: Plan a chunk of work larger than one agent session as a map of decision tickets on the issue tracker, then resolve them one at a time.
